desk.title: CoachOS Desk — one desk for your whole practice
desk.metaDescription: CoachOS Desk runs leads, Marketing Studio, bookings, agreements, billing, client delivery, Practice Intelligence, Autopilot, and Daily Briefing in one system. AI drafts; you approve. Members only.

hero.label: The CoachOS Platform · the core product · members only
hero.sub: Coaches and mentors stitch CRM, calendar, invoicing, and email together — Desk is one record from enquiry to invoice. AI drafts. You approve.

ruleSection.label: The rule on everything
ruleSection.heading: AI drafts. You approve.
ruleSection.intro: The Practice Agent reads context — pipeline history, session notes, open invoices — and drafts the next move. Autopilot handles timing after you approve the wording once. Optional Practice+ adds done-for-you marketing from our team.

steps.title: AI drafts the work
steps.body: Follow-ups, summaries, prep briefs, newsletters, and reminders — generated from your voice and templates, then paused for you.

steps.title: You review exact words
steps.body: One approval queue. Edit or reject. The agent never sends outbound on its own — including on Autopilot recipes.

steps.title: You approve — it sends from you
steps.body: Email Connections mean replies land in your real inbox, from your address. Clients get you.

desk.problemClosing: Desk closes both gaps at once: one record from enquiry to invoice, and AI that drafts the admin — never replaces the human in the room. Starting from zero? Launch Services cover website, domain, and business email before Desk opens.
desk.journeyIntro: One client, end to end. Her name typed once:

rooms.title: 01 — Leads
rooms.desc: Enquiries from your site, social, email, or Shortlist listing land on one pipeline board — Enquiry → Discovery → Proposal → Won. AI scores inbound leads. When someone goes quiet, the Pipeline Agent reads the history and drafts the next follow-up, waiting for your approval.

rooms.title: 02 — Marketing Studio
rooms.desc: Posts, newsletters, and email sequences drafted in your voice from your AI Voice & Rules settings and anonymized session themes. You approve in batches; sends go out from your own address via Email Connections. Social posts are drafted for you — direct publishing expands in later releases.

rooms.title: 03 — Bookings & meetings
rooms.desc: One booking link syncs to your calendar; every booking logs under the right Lead or Client. Sessions run on CoachOS Meet or your Zoom/Meet — recorded, transcribed, and ready for Client Delivery. Reminders and no-show recovery run on your rules.

rooms.title: 04 — Agreements & billing
rooms.desc: Coaching agreement templates pre-fill from the record. E-sign on a phone, legally binding. Invoices queue on acceptance; overdue invoices get chased on the cadence you set — after you approve the reminder wording once.

rooms.title: 05 — Client delivery
rooms.desc: Rough session notes become a warm summary email, private action items, and the next agenda — nothing reaches the client until you approve. Prep briefs arrive 30 minutes before each session. Optional client portal for homework, goals, and progress timeline.

rooms.title: 06 — Practice intelligence
rooms.desc: Revenue, sessions, pipeline health, and retention on one dashboard. AI flags at-risk clients from signals you choose — missed sessions, slower replies, stalled goals — with suggested next actions, not bare numbers.

rooms.title: 07 — Autopilot
rooms.desc: Ready-made recipes you switch on: quiet lead for six days → follow-up; invoice three days late → reminder; session tomorrow → prep brief. You approve the exact wording when you turn a recipe on. After that Autopilot only handles timing — it never invents new words.

rooms.title: 08 — Daily briefing
rooms.desc: Open Desk already caught up: top headlines in your niche, a quick world catch-up, and one thing worth learning today — five minutes, every item linked to its source. One shared edition per niche category, refreshed daily.

rooms.title: 09 — Yours, not ours
rooms.desc: Email Connections send from Gmail, Outlook, or custom SMTP — your address, your inbox. Full data export anytime. Per-coach API key and MCP access for the tools you already use. Your business; Desk runs the admin.

membership.heading: We don't sell seats.
paragraphs: No public signup page. Members are coaches and mentors we already work with through services — people whose practices we know because we helped build the foundation.
When Desk opens for you, it's because we brought you in. That keeps every room worth being in.

roundtable.title: The Roundtable — practice rooms for members
roundtable.metaDescription: The Roundtable is CoachOS's members-only community — rooms by coaching specialty, mentoring practice, freelancer work, small business, L&D, and open topics, plus a Quiet Room for anonymous questions.

hero.sub: ICF 2025 — practice rooms by specialty, not another endless feed where nobody understands the work.

roundtable.intro: The Roundtable is how Coach Community shows up for members today — rooms by practice, not one endless feed. The product roadmap adds a LinkedIn-style network in The Roster; Roundtable is where structured conversation lives.

roster.title: The Roster — your professional network
roster.metaDescription: The Roster is CoachOS's members-only professional network — one profile built from your practice, with posts, referrals, and peer connections that mean something.

hero.sub: 54% of solo operators manage growth by hand — The Roster is peers who already speak your language, inside the system you work in.

roster.intro: The Roster is the network layer of Coach Community — connect, post, comment, and share inside the place you already work, instead of scattered group chats.

shortlist.title: The Shortlist — vetted Coach & Mentor Directory
shortlist.metaDescription: The Shortlist is CoachOS's vetted directory — clients search by specialty, price, and language. Every enquiry routes to your Desk leads board. Listing model: 0% revenue share on what you charge.

hero.sub: Every Shortlist listing is checked, not just paid for — 0% commission on session fees. Enquiries land on your Desk pipeline.

shortlist.intro: The Shortlist is how the Coach & Mentor Directory shows up for members — our own acquisition channel, not a commission marketplace. Listings are vetted; enquiries become Leads in your pipeline.

ruleSection.heading: The rule all four run on
ruleSection.body: On the Platform, AI drafts and the Practice Agent proposes — you always see exact words before anything sends. Our services layer adds a CoachOS specialist in the loop; Desk itself is approval-first, not autopilot outbound.
